parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human target Muscleblind-like protein 1 (CHEMBL1293317). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Filter for assays with organism Homo sapiens. Require structures via INNER JOIN compound_structures. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
